projection.description: Read-only cached native projection. Omit on put: the confirmed cache of the same view kind is retained, and changed source/cut settings mark it stale until explicit update. Supplied caches must equal a previously confirmed native result.

curveReferences.description: Read-only stable roles captured from native curves. Omit when assigning new measured curveIds; unchanged confirmed roles are retained on layout-only put.

unresolved.description: Read-only lost/ambiguous reference status; reassign measured curves or remove the annotation.
